svg.title: LEVI's layers: one entry layer, one capability boundary, domain modules, adapters
svg.desc: The web UI, REST, MCP and CLI all go through one capability layer that enforces permissions, revisions and undo; domain modules sit below it; stores, FFmpeg and model workers at the bottom, with heavy models in isolated environments.

text.font-family: Inter, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, 'Noto Sans', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
Inter, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, 'Noto Sans', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Four interfaces, one boundary, ten domain modules, adapters that can be swapped without touching the rules.

svg.text: Permissions (read · draft · execute · person-only) · revision checks · idempotency keys · undo · audit trail

text.font-family: Inter, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, 'Noto Sans', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: The same rules for the UI, REST, MCP and the CLI: an agent cannot reach a person-only action by another route.

svg.text: Rules that hold in every layer

text.font-family: Inter, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, 'Noto Sans', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Source data is read-only: conversion and export write to new folders. · The core never imports Torch: heavy models run in their own environments.

text.font-family: Inter, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, 'Noto Sans', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Unknown is never success: an unavailable judge is reported as unavailable. · A model's suggestion becomes a label only through a person's commit.

text.font-family: Inter, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, 'Noto Sans', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Every long-running child process is registered and reclaimed on stop or restart.
